root_cause.text: The stream_encoder_create function incorrectly allowed an `eng_id` value of `ENGINE_ID_DIGF` (5) or any negative value due to an improper bounds check (`eng_id <= ENGINE_ID_DIGF`), enabling out-of-bounds indexing into the 5-element `stream_enc_regs[]` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces the original condition `if (eng_id <= ENGINE_ID_DIGF)` with `if (eng_id < 0 || eng_id >= ARRAY_SIZE(stream_enc_regs))`, and the CVE description explicitly notes that `eng_id` can be negative and that the array has only 5 entries, so index 5 is out of bounds.
